name: CSO_KM_WF_SNAPSHOTS
description: This table contains the knowledge management workflow data of a content record.

columns.name: KM_WORKFLOW_SNAPSHOT_ID
columns.description: Primary key of the table. Populated by sequence number.

columns.name: CONTENT_TEXT_ID
columns.description: This is the Reference to content text table record.

columns.name: TASK_ACTED_BY_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the ID of the user who completed the workflow task.

columns.name: TASK_ASSIGNEE_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the ID of the user who is assigned to the workflow task.

columns.name: DESC_LOOKUP_CODE_ID
columns.description: This is the type of comment or user action that caused the history record to be recorded, i.e. APPROVED, REJECTED. Reference to LOOKUP_CODE table.

columns.name: WORKFLOW_INSTANCE_ID
columns.description: This is the unique id for workflow instance.

columns.name: WORKFLOW_STEP_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to workflow step that caused the change.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: The task creation date and time.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: This is the task end date and time.

columns.name: DUE_DATE
columns.description: This is the task due date and time.

columns.name: CURRENT_STEP_FLAG
columns.description: Flag which helps to identify the latest state of an article in workflow.

columns.name: COMPLETED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag which helps to track the completed instances of workflow.

columns.name: CONTENT_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the content history table.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: This is the user provided comment about the change recorded.

columns.name: REJECTIONS_RECEIVED
columns.description: Count of rejections received by the workflow initiator.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_TASK_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: This is the unique id for external task reference associated with this record.

columns.name: ANSWER_ID
columns.description: This is the answerid for the referenced article.

columns.name: NEED_ATTENTION_FLAG
columns.description: Flag which helps to identify the articles which need attention.
